content: Save: DR.serialize_state = Hash#to_s, deserialize_state uses Codegen.eval_hash (eval of Ruby literal text), warns when >20000 chars. DR.read_file/write_file/append_file sandboxed to Win AppData/Roaming/[devtitle]/[gametitle], Mac ~/Library/Application Support/[gametitle], Linux ~/.local/share/[gametitle]. Only parse_json/parse_json_file found for JSON (no generator in mirror). Steam Auto-Cloud supports WinAppDataRoaming/MacAppSupport/LinuxXdgDataHome roots with no SDK.
